parsed.note_claim: The clip shows military footage of an A330 MRTT tanker escorted by Eurofighter Typhoons, not an Air India civilian evacuation, and there is no evidence of fighter-jet-escorted Air India evacuations in the current Gulf crisis.
parsed.label: DOES_NOT_SUPPORT
parsed.reason: The page is about a Mexican senator seeking cooperating-witness status with the US Department of Justice, which is entirely unrelated to Air India evacuations, fighter jets, or the Gulf crisis.
